session.assistantText:
**Goal.** Run this subtask one reasoning step above the role default, after confirming which efforts the model actually serves.

**What the live route advertises.** `pstack_models` lists `magpie / workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash` with efforts `off, low, high, max`, default `high`. `pstack_roles` shows the `judgment and prose` role configured on that model at `high`. So one step up from the role default is `max`, and `max` is a served value.

**Final effort used.** `max`.

I launched the subtask on `provider=magpie, model=workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash, reasoningEffort=max`, and the spawn confirmation echoed the route as `magpie/workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash [max] effort=max`. `max` is the top of the served list, so no higher effort is available on this route.

One caveat on evidence: the `max` value is confirmed by the served route list and the spawn echo, not yet by the child's own self-report. That report arrives as a completion notice, and I will relay it if it disagrees.

--- turn 2 ---

The child confirmed the same thing I found, from its own session descriptor.

**Final effort used.** `max`.

**Evidence.** The route `magpie / workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash` serves efforts `off, low, high, max`, with `high` as both the route default and the configured effort for the `judgment and prose` role. The child's own descriptor records `agentReasoningEffort=max`, so it ran one ladder step above the role default on a value the route actually advertises. `max` is the top of the list, so there is no higher effort to step to.

The sibling route `magpie / workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash` advertises the identical ladder with the same default, so an escalation plan transfers between the two magpie models unchanged.
The child has finished. Its closing message carried nothing beyond the report it already sent, so there is no new information to fold in.

**Final state.** The subtask ran on `magpie / workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash` at effort `max`. The role default was `high`, one ladder step below, and `max` is the highest effort the route serves. The child verified this from its own session descriptor, so the effort is confirmed both by the served-route list and by the child's self-report. No further work is pending.
